pattern: keep groups whose derived change is negative, null rounds drop out
question: list the districts where literate women percent is lower in NFHS-5 than in NFHS-4
gold_sql: SELECT "District" FROM district_health_factsheet WHERE "District" <> 'State Total' GROUP BY "District" HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) < MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) ORDER BY "District"
sql_duckdb: SELECT t1.District FROM district_health_factsheet AS t1 JOIN district_health_factsheet AS t2 ON t1.District = t2.District AND t1.State = t2.State WHERE t1."Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' AND t2."Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' AND t1."Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" > t2."Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)"

attempts.response:
SELECT t1.District
FROM district_health_factsheet t1
JOIN district_health_factsheet t2
ON t1.District = t2.District AND t1.State = t2.State
WHERE t1."Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4'
AND t2."Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5'
AND t1."Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" > t2."Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)"
